title: Success
scene: US post-disco and Hi-NRG; gospel-rooted club soul
notes: Exuberant gospel-charged disco, soaring duet vocals and theatrical orchestrations around It’s Raining Men.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry
notes: Sixties covers and pop-soul choruses meet programmed drums, guitars and powerhouse vocal exchanges.

title: The Weather Girls
scene: Late-1980s US dance-soul and electronic pop
notes: Production-team variety blends brisk synth-pop, disco and soul with emphatic paired lead voices.

title: Double Tons of Fun
scene: European early-1990s club house and disco revival
